G4.5 R0+R1 Implementation Plan v0.1 - Perfect Freehand Reference + C++ Conformance

trusted_statements: G4.5 R0 freezes the perfect-freehand reference source and corpus before implementation.
G4.5 R1 implements a pure renderer-neutral C++ one-shot algorithm conforming to the pinned reference.
R0/R1 does not implement Skia, Web, Android, macOS, Windows, Arc, handoff, canonical schema, or incremental optimization.
The reference geometry contract is ordered closed outline points, not a triangle mesh or centerline stroke.
Streamline and smoothing are distinct reference concepts and must remain distinct internally.
Known upstream sharp-corner/backtracking limitations are reproduced and labeled, not silently fixed under the same algorithm version.
Reference calculations use double precision and expose StrokePoint intermediate data to tests.
The one-shot evaluator remains the future correctness oracle for incremental optimization.
Task GT-G4-5-R01 contains only R0 Reference Source/Corpus Freeze and R1 Pure C++ Algorithm Conformance.
Interrupted 09V P32 head a02ebdb1d811cfbe6e22295ddcacb66cedec49b9 is reconciliation evidence only and is not an execution base.
R0 exit is PF_REFERENCE_FROZEN; R1 exit is PF_GEOMETRY_PARITY_PASS.
Terminal P32 status is READY_FOR_R2_PACKAGE_REVIEW and is not a G4.5 Gate verdict.
